title: PP Sheet Site Cutting Demo

segments.vo: PP sheet cutter se kategi kya?
Normal cutter se bilkul ply ki tarah aaram se kat ti hai.
Apne size mein kaato, mistri aur thekedar ko share karo.

end_vo: Comment mein PP likhiye, follow kijiye, rate aapke DM mein.
caption:
VAJRA PP shuttering sheet ko site pe normal cutter se aaram se kaat sakte hain, bilkul ply ki tarah.

Koi special tool nahi chahiye, beam aur slab ke hisaab se manchaaha size banayein. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.
